blocks.text: Colors filled Mactan Shrine in Lapu-Lapu City on Sunday evening, Sept. 27, when the delegates of the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International pageant showcased their cultures on stage. The international pageant’s National Costume Competition was a spectacle of grandiose creations that reflect the heritage of the 38 participating countries in this year’s competition. Spectators watching at the open-air venue were mesmerized as the delegates paraded one-by-one to present the costumes that show facets of their countries’ culture and tradition. Sandeepa Sewmini Don Samarasinghe Disanayake from Sri Lanka romped away with the Best in National Costume award at the end of the […]...
